recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future substantive changes to questionnaire-minOccurs or questionnaire-maxOccurs should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue requesting standard extensions so a Questionnaire question that allows multiple answers can constrain the number of allowed answers.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly naming FHIR-3145 or {#3145} was found. Historical core source did contain source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-minOccurs.xml and source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-maxOccurs.xml, whose definitions expressed the requested minimum and maximum answer/repetition counts. Those files were later deleted from active R5 source by the broad extension move commit dd468d4f17.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Questionnaire active but has no active profile entry for questionnaire-minOccurs or questionnaire-maxOccurs. The current canonical extension definitions live in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-questionnaire-minOccurs.xml and StructureDefinition-questionnaire-maxOccurs.xml. Later Extension Pack maintenance issues FHIR-48948 and FHIR-43033, plus historical core typo issue FHIR-15916, confirm the artifacts are maintained outside the core checkout and that the current maxOccurs wording is corrected.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because reintroducing duplicate extension definitions into core would be outside the current build scope and would conflict with the extension-pack split.
